The harmonic mean check also holds: 2·80·120/(80+120) = 96. The step-by-step working is clear and shows the key reasoning, namely that the slower leg takes more time, so the simple average of 100 km/h is wrong. It is well under 120 words, and the extra note on the harmonic mean adds useful insight without padding.
